reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay but felt that a few homey amenities would really make a difference, especially considering the price: reading lamps, quality tp and kleenex, larger bath towels, woodstove prepared for use, smaller pots and pans and plates in kitchen, safety mats in tub/shower plus grab bars, lap blankets. The loosely placed concrete that constituted the walkway to the hot tub did not seem up to code.

hostResponse.text:
Thank you for staying with us and for the thoughtful feedback. We’re glad you enjoyed your visit.
For future guests, here’s what’s provided: two lamps per bed in three of the four bedrooms, a lamp in the living room, and lamps at the bedroom work desks. Lap blankets are on the living room couch, with extras in the hallway closet. Bathroom have non-slip bath mats under the sink, and we stock 2-ply toilet paper. The wood stove is cleaned regularly, and we supply lighters, kindling paper, and complimentary firewood. We keep the wood outside to prevent bugs from getting into the house but are happy to put some inside with advanced notice if moving firewood is a concern for your party.
Guest safety is a priority for us, so we’re taking another look at the hot tub walkway. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention.
If anything is ever missing during a stay, please message us. We respond quickly and are happy to help. Thanks again for staying with us!

reviews.text: Amazing house! The pictures do not do it justice at all. such an amazing space and very well kept, the owners really love and care for this place. Would 100% stay here again!

James is a wonderful host. He was quick to respond to any questions and made sure we were feeling like at home. The home was very clean, tidy, and provided a peaceful environment that welcomed all ages. There was plenty to do on site and the home was spread out to accommodate multiple people. The best thing about this place is that everything listed about the property on the booking site was 100% accurate and that it is a 2 min drive to the Big Creek Campground. 10/10 would book again and recommend to everyone.

hostResponse.text: We aim to always provide an accurate listing. We're so glad you could spread out in the large space and enjoyed the clean and peaceful environment!

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful time at James’s place in Ashford! We stayed here with family and a toddler, and it was the perfect setup for us. The home was incredibly spacious, well-furnished, and you can tell it was recently renovated—everything felt fresh and very clean.
One of the highlights of our stay was the local "neighbors"—we had deer visiting the property every now and then, which was a magical experience for the whole family. The location is also unbeatable if you are visiting Mt. Rainier National Park; the entrance is so close, making our daily trips very easy.
James was a fantastic host and had the house arranged so neatly for our arrival. We truly loved our stay here and can’t recommend it enough for families looking for a peaceful, high-quality getaway near the mountain. We’d love to come back!

hostResponse.text: Thank you, Radhika! Thanks for highlighting the spacious layout, recent renovations, and convenient location near Mount Rainier. We're always touched to see the local deer "neighbors" too! We hope to see you again!
